outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 907 refugee infants and 48,506 Turkish infants born in a Turkish hospital
finding: Refugee infants in Turkey had a lower maternal age, higher rates of SGA and LGA, higher incidence of jaundice and perinatal asphyxia, but similar infant mortality rates compared to Turkish infants.
mod_finding: Refugees required fewer cesarean sections than Turkish women.
gest_age: Similar between refugees and Turkish women
birth_weight: Similar between refugees and Turkish women
